messages:
Alex Kim: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to lock down SLO/SLA updates and an action sprint for the recurring latency tails observed last month. Summarizing in this thread so we have a clear owner/timeline.
Jordan Patel: +1. Can you paste the micro-summary of the pattern? I want to confirm scope before we change SLOs.
Alex Kim: Pattern = repeated p95 spikes around autoscale events, and p99 tail growth during bursty RPC fanouts. Happened 4 times over 3 weeks, mostly during batch cache evictions.
Samira Ortiz: Agreed. From the dashboard: weekly p95 median ~120ms but spikes to ~260ms during the events. p99 steady at ~420ms. Error budget burn was ~0.8% for Mar.
Micah Lee: Do we have a hypothesis owner for root cause? I think runtime cache eviction logic + routing to cold pool is likely.
Alex Kim: Micah to own investigation for cache eviction -> 2 week spike mitigation. Jordan will own SLO proposal and alert tuning. Samira will own dashboard + regression evals.
Jordan Patel: Proposed SLO adjustments to discuss: p95 < 150ms (global), p99 < 350ms (tiered for dedicated vs hosted), and throughput target to reflect autoscale buffers: 4k steady RPS, 10k burst. Also suggest creating a new tail-monitor alert that triggers when p99 > 350ms for 10m.
Samira Ortiz: I can add the new graphs and a dashboard panel for burst windows. Will add a PromQL snapshot and query to the playbook.
Micah Lee: For mitigation timeline: week 0-1 triage + reproducibility, week 2 implement soft-prefetch + KV cache hysteresis, week 3 canary, week 4 roll. Owner = Micah.
Alex Kim: Good. Action items: 1) Jordan: draft formal SLO doc and alert thresholds by Wed EOD (GH PR). 2) Micah: triage runbook + PoC by next Tue. 3) Samira: dashboard + alert on-call links by Fri. 4) Alex: coordinate canary schedule with infra.
Jordan Patel: I'll open GH issue and PR with the SLO proposal: will include proposed SLA language for Dedicated customers. Link once ready.
Samira Ortiz: Dashboard query I'll add (PromQL):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```
Will also add a 99th percentile panel and a compare view vs autoscale events.
oncall-bot: Incident 2468013001 closed — summary posted to #incidents.
Alex Kim: Let's do a weekly 15-min sync for the sprint: Thursdays 9am PT. Will update calendar and add owners to the checklist. Please put blockers in the GH issue. :thumbsup:
Micah Lee: Noted, will start with flaky repro harness and attach logs.
Jordan Patel: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/slo/pulls/142 (draft) — feedback welcome.
Samira Ortiz: Dashboard PR up next. I'll tag the monitoring team.
Alex Kim: Thanks all — we'll reconvene Thu. If anyone sees an immediate customer impact, escalate to oncall and ping me.
